mechanism: Disulfiram inhibits CYP3A4 and CYP2D6, increasing risperidone plasma concentrations and CNS depression risk; both agents may potentiate sedation and orthostatic hypotension.
action: Monitor for increased risperidone adverse effects (sedation, orthostasis, extrapyramidal symptoms); consider risperidone dose reduction and ensure patient safety precautions, particularly during alcohol abstinence when disulfiram effects are pronounced.
